Bill.BriefDescription: Including utility easements and rights-of-way in the acreage calculation under the open space taxation act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to utility easements and rightsofway under theopen space taxation act; adding a new section to chapter 84.34 RCW; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.34 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An owner of land desiring current use classification under RCW84.34.020 (2)(a), (b), or (c) or (3) may include adjacent land used byan electric light and power company or gas company through an easementor rightofway in the acreage determination under RCW 84.34.020(2)(a), (b), or (c) or (3). The land used by the company through aneasement or rightofway is not subject the gross income, land use,ownership, and other requirements under RCW 84.34.020 (2)(a), (b), or(c) or (3). The land used by the electric light and power company orgas company must be owned or have been previously owned by the ownerseeking current use classification. (2) "Electric light and power company" and "gas company" have thesame meanings as provided in RCW 84.12.200. "Electric light and powercompany" includes the Bonneville power administration.
(1) This act applies to taxes levied forcollection in 2012 and thereafter. (2) This act applies to land that is modified or disqualified underthe open space act on or after January 1, 2006.
